scope: Real host scheduler with a deterministic PowerShell adapter; no real PDF reader speed claim.
checks: Duplicate background reads are rejected without blocking foreground controls
Pause finishes the current PDF and preserves a cumulative 1/8 checkpoint
Paused reading launches no additional PDF helper
Foreground Approve completes while paused and its latest snapshot is retained
Independent Trends data and static asset routes are available during reading
A foreground action queued during a PDF runs before the archive batch completes
One-PDF requests are sanitized, mutations stay serialized, and cancel preserves cumulative work
A bulk action stops after twenty actual PDFs and reports the remaining work
Shutdown cancels background reading at a safe checkpoint and leaves no running helper
